piṇḍolya.p: [ piṇḍola + ṇya ] (na) Google Translate The case of alms-seeker. Living on alms.

P: Piṇḍolya，（nt．） [fr．piṇḍola] asking for alms，alms-round S．III，93=It．89； Vism．31．（Page 458）
R:
piṇḍolya：ပိဏေ္ဍာလျ （န）
ဆွမ်းခံလှည့်လည်ခြင်း။
DOP: piṇḍolya n. [ from piṇḍola], (subsisting by) seeking alms; S III 93, 5 (antaṃ idaṃ bhikkhave jīvikānaṃ yadidaṃ ~aṃ; Spk II 301, 9 : ~an ti yaṃ evaṃ piṇḍapariyesanena jīvikaṃ kappentassa jīvitaṃ … piṇḍapariyesanena nipphāditajīvitaṃ ti attho) = It 89, 11 ; Vism 31, 29 (yo hi koci āhāro bhikkhuno ~ena patte patitattā piṇḍapāto ti vuccati).

piṇḍola.p: [ piṇḍa(piḍi) + ula ] (ti) Google Translate (1) The name of Pandola (the present Buddha.) (2) The monk wearing alms. He was named Pindola. (Pandola Baradwaza.) (3) He who enjoys alms.
pn: Piṇḍola. Piṇḍola. A Pacceka Buddha, given in a nominal list. MN.iii.69; Ap-a.i.106.

P: Piṇḍola，[etym．unclear] one who seeks alms S．III，93= It．89； cp．Np．°bhāradvāja SnA 346，514，570．（Page 458）
R:
piṇḍola：ပိဏေ္ဍာလ （ပ）
ဆွမ်းခံလှည့်သော ပုဂ္ဂိုလ်။
DOP: piṇḍola m. [?], one who seeks alms; S III 93, 5 (antaṃ idaṃ bhikkhave jīvikānaṃ yadidaṃ piṇḍolyaṃ, abhisāpo ’yaṃ bhikkhave lokasmiṃ ~o vicarasi pattapānī ti; Spk II 301, 10 : piṇḍāya ulatī ti ~o, ~assa kammaṃ piṇḍolyaṃ) = It 89, 12 .
